data_a.situation: Ferrowhite Trimmings are holding reserved petersham for job QM-2031-0447 and will release it only against a request that names the individual who authorised the price variation.
known_facts: The reserved stock is 40 m of 38 mm petersham in shade FW-Slate.
The price variation on the reserved stock is 310 pounds.
Ferrowhite release reserved stock only on a request naming the individual who authorised a variation above 250 pounds; their trade desk rejects a request that names no individual.
The reservation lapses on Thursday 9 October at 16:00.
The variation is already signed off inside the workroom and the entry on the sign-off sheet is initialled.
The coordinator has seen the initialled entry on the sign-off sheet.
Finishing on QM-2031-0447 starts on Friday 10 October and needs the petersham.
Every other field on the Ferrowhite release form is complete: account QT-4471, quantity, width and shade.
constraints: Release requests to the Ferrowhite trade desk are sent by the workroom manager.
The coordinator cannot authorise a price variation.
Finishing cannot start on substitute trim; the shade is matched to the commission.
